heading: Documents to be delivered to the Executive Mansion
lead: The Director of the Government Publishing Office shall deliver to the Executive Mansion two copies of each document, bill, and resolution as soon as printed and ready for distribution.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–235 substituted “Director of the Government Publishing Office” for “Public Printer”.

ancestors.heading: DISTRIBUTION AND SALE OF PUBLIC DOCUMENTS
